games.name: Paths to Immortality [Ver. 0.6]
games.desc:
Paths to Immortality is an Incremental RPG where your goal is to reach immortality. Join a sect or go solo, cultivate peacefully or battle your way to the top. Reach your goals by harnessing your affinities; incinerate the world with your fire, or destroy all life with a plague. The choice is yours, the paths are endless. 

Update will release sometime this summer, 2025. [Small delay due to personal reasons but it's still coming]
Will have data reset due to a complete rework of the game. Unique Items to people who played before the update releases. 

Game heavily inspired by Theory of Magic and Your Chronicle, check those out.

games.name: Arena Football 4
games.desc:
Welcome to Arena Football 4!
Fast paced, high scoring, indoor football action.

Arena Football was created in 1987 bringing a unique style of football to the sports entertainment world. An on-going clock, a field surrounded in barricades, nets at the end of each endzone to keep the play alive.

Experience all of this and more right here!

go to LOCKED:2

"Either you win or you lose. While you were getting excited over your mediocre successes, true strikers tread a path of winning or losing everything. Every single day, in order to keep on surviving."

Create dribble styles, dominate in your position, score every goal. Choose the impact you want to make in LOCKED, a Blue Lock inspired Roblox game.

(It is recommended to play LOCKED with keyboard and mouse. No mobile combability)

PLAYER CONTROLS:

M1 - Dribble
M2 - Shoot
Q - Slide Tackle
R - Weapon
T - Trait
G - Flow
V - Charge Stamina
SHIFT - Run
CTRL - Shift-Lock

GK CONTROLS: (Keybindable)

Z - Dive Left
F - Hand Block
Q - Front Dive
E - Pick/Drop Ball

!training on/off
!server lock/unlock
!kick playername
!admin playername
!flyperms playername
!fly
!ball
